title: Signals, Bias, and a Smooth Curve

lines.text: Three weights shape each signal's path
Bias one joins the weighted sum
Inputs one, zero, one roll in
Z is point five, minus one, plus two
Add minus one to two point five
One point five is greater than zero
Step says one, the gate will fire
Smooth sigmoid gives point eight two
Update makes z minus one point five

predict.question: Bias is -1, weighted sum is 2.5. If the bias were -3, would it fire?
